Mitochondria generate ATP through cellular respiration. Chloroplasts use light for photosynthesis.

# Password security
Argon2 hashes passwords. HttpOnly session cookies prevent JavaScript from reading the cookie. CSRF tokens protect state-changing requests.
Reciprocal Rank Fusion adds 1 divided by constant plus rank for each result list. BM25 matches keywords. Vector retrieval compares embeddings.
The Moon orbits Earth. The Sun is a star. Jupiter is the largest planet in the solar system.
Water has the formula H2O. At standard atmospheric pressure water boils at 100 degrees Celsius.

# Course handbook
The research methods quiz takes place in room LAB-204 on Tuesday. Students should bring a notebook.
